title: Room Alphabet · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Room Alphabet · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a letter that starts the names of at least two visible objects. The lead names two objects in view whose common names begin with that letter. The group can see both objects and agrees on their names. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Room Alphabet, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can see both objects and agrees on their names.
recall.why: The group can see both objects and agrees on their names.
